proposal.observation: Round 2 produced identical metrics and before/after images, showing that lowering the oblique Hough threshold does not affect this case's active path. The unchanged incumbent still has a 0.1821 depth-NaN ratio and only 0.5969 SAM fill, and the depth image contains broad repeated voids despite an exact 10-ring count and coherent prompt spacing.
proposal.rule: When ring geometry and prompt count are stable but depth holes and under-coverage remain high, prioritize the ontology's upstream radial-gate widening remediation over further detection or SAM-template changes.
proposal.rationale: Widening both radial limits to their allowed bounds is a direct bounded test of whether lining points are being discarded before projection. It targets depth-map support and fill while leaving the successful degree-2 unfolding, exact ring count, and detection/SAM geometry unchanged.
